newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Shots fired at Guatemalan jail riot, inmate hurt.
newsitem.headline: Shots fired at Guatemalan jail riot, inmate hurt.

text.p: A riot broke out in Guatemala City's main jail on Tuesday and a prisoner was wounded inside the compound, local radio reported.

Army and police forces both inside and outside the compound fired warning shots into the air and launched tear gas into the Zone 18 Prevention Centre for Men after prisoners took over a prison wing, throwing rocks and furniture off the roof.
An army helicopter was circling over the prison and riot police, military police, the national guard and the army took up positions outside.
Top officials from the Interior Ministry were inside the prison trying to negotiate an end to the uprising, witnesses said.
"A group of them (the prisoners) wants to escape," a police officer who refused to give his name told Reuters.
Reasons for the revolt were vague, but they appeared to have stemmed from a security clampdown in the jail after a well-known prisoner, held on kidnapping charges, escaped on Sunday night.
A large contingent of army and police reinforcements has surrounded the prison since.
Radio Sonora reported that first-aid workers carried Francis Mendez, 27, out of the prison with a bullet wound to the thorax. It was not clear how he was shot.
